text_block_list.text: —Why can't we ever get proper rest?

"Health comes first"—I should know
something that obvious, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*Zzz*... *zzz*...
*Zzz*... *zzz*... Mmmnh...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's already afternoon...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Tran-san. Or rather, afternoon.
You've been fast asleep this whole time.
Are you feeling alright...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, no worries, no worries. Don't sweat it.
Can't get through life without catching up on sleep~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, days off just fly by...
Aah, I wish a day had 30 hours~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, cleared the whole thing~~~!
Heheh, I really wanted to play to my heart's content~.
I never have time on weekdays!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Playing games after so long is the beeeest...
A nice change of pace..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuugh...? My eyes are blinking like crazyyy!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, are you alright, Teio-chan?
Should I fetch some eye drops?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whew...
I should probably at least do this much, right?
I'd hate to be sluggish after the break...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...! Another runner detected.
Pausing temporarily for collision avoidance.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good work today!
Are you running too, Bourbon-san... wait, guess not.
Um, were you in a hurry for something?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No. Currently executing Operation:
'Return Home from Leisure Activity.'
This task has no time limit.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The one who was running was............ The one there... was...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Why is this happening... The cause is unknown.
Error, occurring...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Still, I understand. Rest days always leave you feeling a bit restless, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: When I'm slacking off, I get this feeling of guilt... Like, I start wondering if everyone back home is working hard right now, and—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...
Even Tarumae-chan and the others...
—And come Monday, the results of the recent health checkups arrived for the Academy's Trainers.

What a disaster...!
I've been forced to face the reality
I had been turning a blind eye to.
"Day after busy day. I had a nagging feeling that chronic fatigue was catching up to me..."

"The things I need to do and want to do are piling up.
There's no time to stand still.
Yet, if things continue like this, I will hit a limit eventually."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, you look down in the dumps.
What's the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're looking rather pale, too.
Are you eating properly?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Could it be... are you tired as well?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Everyone at this academy is so busy, aren't they?
I suppose that means their lives are fulfilling, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm just worried sick... I guess that's just how times change, huh.

—The day after all that happened,
an unusual announcement was made at the school assembly.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What a stroke of luck! True, utter good fortune!
An invitation to a hot spring getaway~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's have them explain the details
themselves in person!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And now, taking the stage!
One of the URA's premier retreat facilities!
It's the crew from the "Yukoma Hot Springs"~!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Sound
text_block_list.text:
(—*Tsukuten-tsukuten, tsukuten-ten*♪
—*Tsukuten-tsukuten, tsukuten-ten*♪)

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—Yu~~~koma, what a wonderful place...♪
—The water is so nice and warm...♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Haaah~~ Yum yum!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—Yu~~~koma Hot Springs~~...♪
Pyoiya! Soi-soi!

A hush falls over the gymnasium at the sudden turn of events.
It's a rather goofy song, but still...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
W-What a voice!
A truly magnificent performance!
Everyone, give it up~~~!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Proprietress, it's a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Indeed.
choice_data_list: (What in the world is going on...?)

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, everyone.
My apologies for making a spectacle of myself.
What you just heard was the traditional "Bath-Treading Song" passed down in our hot spring village.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for not introducing myself sooner.
I am the proprietress of Yukoma Ryokan,
Kenko Hoshina.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"And as for me,
I am currently training to be her successor...
My name is Yunohana Bloom."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"I am what you might call the 'young proprietress.'
It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance♪"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's pull ourselves together...
and allow me to guide you through this hot spring cure.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Here at our hot spring resort, we have long pursued the ultimate in
hot spring health retreats for the rehabilitation and refreshment of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"We extended this invitation in hopes that everyone
at Tracen Academy would make even greater use
of the healing powers of our hot springs."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Well aren't you generous.
So basically, it's for publicity, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
To reach Yukoma Hot Spring Resort, it takes about an hour
via the direct shuttle bus from in front of the academy♪
Access is fantastic, too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? I've never seen a bus like that in front of the academy, though...? D-Don't tell me, the Chairwoman...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! ARRANGED!
Fear not, Tazuna gave her permission this time!
After all, it defeats the purpose if you cannot drop by casually!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
I am truly grateful for this.

So it's unlikely to interfere with training.
In that case, <chrname> should be able
to attend, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fuhooooo!
This is it, this right here!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This is exactly what everyone needs right now.
After all, who could possibly fuss and fret when they've come all the way to a hot spring inn?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, quite true.
A change of scenery
always helps reset one's mood, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes...! With this, even those who usually struggle to rest properly should be able to get a good night's sleep, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, eveeeeryone
should be able to keep running with energy...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume, humans...
Hey, you too, Trainer.
Wonder Acute's words make total sense. Putting off problems just because it's hard to find time to rest isn't right...

To keep running together with <chrname> forever,
we need to stay healthy.
Both her and myself!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, you can't overlook rest
as an athlete.
A hot spring retreat sounds tempting...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Totally agree~
Resting in a different environment than usual
sounds like a great breath of fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring, huh~? Might be nice to go to one after so long♪
I'm kind of tired of spending all my days off gaming anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Re-evaluating rest." It does seem worth considering.
However, commuting back and forth would take up a considerable amount of time...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Initiating calculations.
Calculating disadvantages...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"You're right.
I totally understand finding it bothersome, even if it's nearby."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: "『Going out is such a draaag. I'd rather just sleep in my roooom...』"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: You can't help but think that, right?
choice_data_list: Ugh...! Some days are just like that, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I've brought this invitation.
Come give it a 'trial run,'
and if you like it, you can visit regularly for hot spring therapy...♪"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: I will give you my absolute best hospitality.
choice_data_list: A "trial run," huh... Then by all means!

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to visit the Yukoma Hot Springs
on our next day off. Just what is
a hot spring recuperation like...?
